name: hygge-cache
description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm with a silent fork ping and refuses idle compaction, so coming back after a break reads the cache instead of rewriting it, with every detail still there.

enabled.title: Keep idle sessions warm
enabled.description: Off stops every ping and lets idle compaction run. Changing it in /config reloads the plugin with the new value.

intervalMinutes.title: Ping after idle minutes
intervalMinutes.description: Minutes since the last request before a ping goes out. Checked every five minutes. Keep it under the cache lifetime.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime in minutes
ttlMinutes.description: 60 on a subscription inside plan usage. On an API key, a cloud provider, or usage credits it is 5 unless promptCacheTtl says 1h; at 5 nothing pings.

minContextK.title: Minimum context in thousands of tokens
minContextK.description: Sessions smaller than this are left to cool; a cold read of them is cheap.

giveUpAfterHours.title: Give up after idle hours
giveUpAfterHours.description: Stop pinging a session nobody has typed in for this long. Each ping is one cache read; a cold return is one cache write, worth 20 to 80 reads. The context is kept either way.

compactAbovePercent.title: Let idle compaction through above this much of the context window
compactAbovePercent.description: Below it an idle compaction is refused and the full context kept. Above it the engine compacts, since a turn that overflows the window fails.
